answer.action: Submit monthly Non-Resident Deposits (NRD-CSR) returns through the CIMS Sankalan portal using system-to-system integration, file upload, or web form on or before the 10th of each month.
answer.action_quote: The NRD-CSR report may be submitted on or before 10th of the month following the month to which the NRD data pertains.
answer.amends: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 19 dated August 07, 2013
